observed: The toolchain inside the sandbox image changed twice while the run was in progress. Because each tool call is `docker run --rm` on a fresh container, nothing an agent installs in-container persists; the change had to be made to the image itself (rebuild, `docker commit`, or a re-tag) by an actor outside the run. The package attributes it to nobody. Consequence for the evidence: two verdicts of the same story, seconds apart, ran against different toolchains under the same recorded image name.
expected: Evidence about a verification run identifies the environment it ran in well enough to be re-run: the guide records the image name; a mid-run change of the image is not something the framework can prevent, but the evidence should make it visible (an image id/digest per tool_run) instead of silently recording the same tag for two different images.
class_note: The mutation is an operator/environment action. The provenance gap (no image digest in tool_run evidence) would be a product change in aisef/harness; whether it is required is the owner's call → requires_product_change unresolved.
